How to Host on GitHub Pages

Free, fast, and live at ahmedothman206.github.io

You can host this entire portfolio for free using GitHub Pages. Anyone visiting your link will see this interactive site!

Step 1: Create a GitHub Repository

Log in to github.com and create a new public repository named:

ahmedothman206.github.io
Step 2: Add index.html

Upload or push this single index.html file to the root of your repository.

Step 3: Enable GitHub Pages

In your GitHub repository, go to Settings → Pages.

Under Build and deployment → Branch, choose main (or master) and folder / (root), then click Save.

Step 4: Your Live Link is Ready!

Within 60 seconds, your site is live at: https://ahmedothman206.github.io
